subject: Oil drain: loosening the drain plug with a 17 mm socket, on a 2010 BMW 328i (E90) with the 3.0L inline-6, shown so a home mechanic can see what the step is about. Step: "Drain the sump".

mustShow.text: HERO: The engine oil drain plug seen end-on, a short external hex head with a copper-coloured crush washer, with the socket fitted over its head. Do NOT depict its orientation: keep it a plain generic shape.

A plain chrome 17 mm socket fitted over the plug head, on a plain ratchet whose handle extends away from the plug; no markings or engraving. Do NOT depict its fine detail: keep it a plain generic shape.
